ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Approximate 12:88 ratio of high-intensity (white/light-grey) to low-intensity (dark-grey/black) pixels across visible ventral surface.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: Dominant low-intensity black region covering central body. High-intensity mottling concentrated at the far-left and far-right distal tips. Sparse high-intensity micro-speckling distributed across the lower portions of both lobes.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep V-shaped depression with an approximate interior angle of 40 degrees; vertex oriented toward the peduncle.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: High-frequency, irregular serrations along the continuous trailing boundary. Prominent jagged peaks localized at the outer-right lobe extremity and across the mid-sections of both lobes.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Convex curvature from the distal tips tapering toward the central notch.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: Concentrated cluster of high-intensity circular nodes at the far-left proximal edge. Numerous isolated high-intensity points (speckles) on the lower ventral surface.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Two prominent, nearly parallel high-intensity linear tracks on the inner left lobe. Multiple fine, unaligned linear markings within the left-tip high-intensity region.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent parallel rake marks on the left lobe; irregular, high-amplitude jaggedness on the distal right trailing edge indicating previous tissue loss or impact.
other_distinctive_markers: Unique filigree pigmentation pattern within the high-intensity cluster on the far-left tip.
